name: Munda Wanga Environmental Park
subtitle: A botanical garden south of Lusaka, begun in 1950 by a colonial official who named it 'My Garden' in Nyanja.

facts.value: Sander died in 1978 after selling the estate to the Government

parts.text: A botanical garden south of Lusaka, begun in 1950 by a colonial official who named it 'My Garden' in Nyanja. It was later sold to the government.
